title: feat(auth): branded, refined-centered auth shell
body:
## Summary
Beautifies the **login-related pages**. All unauthenticated Console surfaces (login / register / forgot-password / reset-password / verify-email / setup / oauth-consent / device / accept-invitation) share `apps/console/src/pages/auth/AuthLayout.tsx`, so polishing the shell lifts every one of them at once.

### Changes (`AuthLayout.tsx` — Console-local only)
- **Brand identity, server-driven** — a restrained brand mark (layered "stack" glyph on the indigo→violet gradient + product wordmark) now sits above the form card. The product name comes from `getProductName()` (`@object-ui/app-shell` runtime-config `branding.productName`, default **`ObjectOS`**, overridable via `RuntimeConfigPlugin` / server branding) — **never a hard-coded vendor name**, so downstream operators rebrand the auth surface without code changes. Previously the only thing above the card was a dev-ish `LOCALHOST:5180` host pill.
- **Refined canvas** — replaced the flat `bg-muted` background with a near-neutral surface + a faint, edge-fading **dot-grid** and a single **soft brand glow** behind the card. Calm and content-first (consistent with the home page direction), not a marketing color wash.
- **Less dev noise** — the host pill is suppressed on local/loopback hosts (`localhost` / `127.0.0.1` / `.local`), where it conveyed no tenant meaning. It still appears for real tenant subdomains so SSO users can confirm which workspace they're entering.

### Deliberately left alone
The auth **form primitives** (submit button, inputs, focus rings) live in the shared, theme-driven `@object-ui/auth` package and render via the `--primary` token. They are untouched, so downstream white-label theming is unaffected — the button keeps the app's own primary color.

## Naming note
`ObjectStack` = the developer-tool vendor; `ObjectOS` = the released runtime product. The wordmark shows the **product** name (`ObjectOS` by default), per the existing server-driven branding mechanism — not the vendor name.

## Testing
- Browser-verified **login** and **register** in light and dark mode — wordmark renders `ObjectOS`, subtle depth behind the card, no console errors.
